name: Enterprise Competency, Qualification and Credential
constraints: WM-PER-009 owns scheme-version-qualified Skill and Competency definitions; Skill and Competency remain distinct typed profiles.
Competency Assessment profiles WM-ACT-034 with pinned criteria, method, scale, evidence, assessor competence and immutable finalization.
Qualification reuses WM-PER-008 and Credential reuses WM-XCT-017 with WM-PER-013 as the professional-licence profile.
Issuance, technical verification, current validity and present competence remain separate judgements.
Position requirements remain role expectations and never assertions about an occupant.
Self-declared, assessed, credential-derived and observed capability bases remain distinct.
